recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; FHIR-15742 is already correctly reflected in the current FHIR core search page, and later related _summary extension work is already handled by its own issue history.
issue_request: FHIR-15742 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core-search change request asking to tighten loose _summary=true expectations by changing the description to a limited subset that SHOULD consist solely of all supported base-definition summary elements and by flagging extension inclusion for balloters.
initial_application: Git commit 51dde1be9cb0c2f07ceb1f49c45ee9c2ff676087, matching the Jira comment svn 14267, explicitly applied GF#15742 to source/search.html by replacing the old 'Return only those elements marked as summary' sentence with the approved limited-subset SHOULD wording and adding an implementers note about extensions.
additional_context: The March 2018 Zulip thread 'Extensions when _summary=true?' shows the extension and looseness concern that prompted GF#15742, and FHIR-I minutes on 2018-03-19 list tracker 15742 as Persuasive. Later Published issues FHIR-33002 and FHIR-35865 refined nearby _summary=text and modifierExtension behavior without superseding the FHIR-15742 _summary=true rule.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/search.html says _summary=true returns a limited subset whose supported elements SHOULD be base-definition summary elements and includes current extension guidance saying servers MAY return extensions in summary mode while clients should not rely on them.
